method: Viewed actual final Electron PNGs with view_image, compared template direction against read-only Braun.png and FAMICOM.png.
observations: Single Shaco Sidebar and work area; no visible Harness shell, Hero or product branding. Provider/model names remain legitimate catalog data.
BRAUN neutral gray/white surfaces and restrained controls; FAMICOM cream/red surfaces, top stripe and alternate typography/control recipe.
Conversation/Composer/Tool aligned; responsive controls remain reachable in narrow window; long messages scroll within their content area.
Approval, question and plan/multi forms remain distinct from Composer with explicit actions.
Command messages now show public command/args/outcome without seq/time/commandId records.
Loading and revoked-root error use Shaco-only surfaces.
Settings exposes real template and mode selectors.
limits: Visual conformance is to frozen V1 structure and visual direction, not pixel-identical recreation of illustrative future launchers/assets.
Streaming/Tool content is explicitly marked non-Provider local Host fixture; not actual model or external Tool execution.
